question: Is a ~90% 'interpretation' of crop state supported by field-level composition? No.
conclusion: 90% interpretation is not supported by any measured signal in this data. Field-level composition is a RE-STRUCTURED TARGET, not a claim that crop state can be read from satellite at 90%.
what_would_be_needed: per-crop geometry (R5.8 blocker), per-date temporal sequences, calibration data - none available locally.
